basic_info.description: Step into 1283 Howard St, a beautifully renovated condo blending contemporary elegance with SoMa's vibrant energy. This light-filled 4-bed, 2-bath home spans 1,519 sq. ft., offering a stylish sanctuary for modern living and entertaining.    ✨ Bright & Airy: Skylights flood the open-concept living spaces with natural light, highlighting sleek finishes and designer touches.  🛌 Luxurious Primary Suite: Features an en-suite bath and custom walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms offer versatility for guests, a home office, or creative spaceone currently serves as an extra walk-in closet.  🍳 Chef's Kitchen: Boasts premium stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and ample storage, seamlessly connecting to the living and dining areas.  📍 Prime SoMa Location: Steps from top restaurants, cafes, and SFMOMA, with easy access to Downtown SF, AI hubs, and highways 101/280 for seamless commuting.  💡 Future-Ready: Seller open to cryptocurrency transactions, offering a modern buying opportunity.    A rare turnkey home where innovation meets inspirationexperience sophisticated city living at 1283 Howard St!
